_comment: Versioned, additive media catalogue for the Model Hub. A family is 'supported' ONLY when PaRuX owns a workflow template for it (registryFamily points at a supported media-companion-registry family); everything else is 'resolver_only' with an honest reason and is shown but never offered for download. 'tier' is a DECLARED quality tier (1-5) chosen by the catalogue author from public model-family positioning; it is not a benchmark and is always labelled declared in the UI. sizeBytes is set ONLY when listingVerified is true (checked against the repository listing); otherwise size is derived from parametersBillion x precision and labelled so. 'license' is the publisher's declared licence shown as a hint; the real licence evidence and consent come from the download consent flow. 'lane' is standard unless the repository itself declares an uncensored/abliterated nature, and an uncensored entry must carry laneEvidence. Every uncensored entry was checked against its repository listing and quotes the evidence phrase from that repository's own README or tags; an entry whose repository does not say so stays in the standard lane. An optional per-variant sampling object (steps, cfg, sampler, scheduler) and promptPrefix carry what the checkpoint's own model card recommends.

variants.title: Z-Image Turbo (bf16, full precision)
variants.baseCompat: Same text encoder and VAE as the bundled Z-Image Turbo workflow.

variants.title: Z-Image Turbo (int8)
variants.baseCompat: Same text encoder and VAE as the bundled Z-Image Turbo workflow.

variants.title: Z-Image Turbo (nvfp4, PaRuX default)
variants.baseCompat: The checkpoint PaRuX workflows load by default.

variants.title: FLUX.2 klein 4B (distilled, PaRuX default)
variants.baseCompat: The checkpoint PaRuX edit workflow loads by default.

variants.title: FLUX.2 klein 4B (base, non-distilled)
variants.baseCompat: Same architecture, text encoder and VAE as the distilled default; likely needs more sampling steps.

variants.title: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B (fp16, PaRuX default)
variants.baseCompat: The checkpoint PaRuX video workflow loads by default; the repackage ships one precision.

variants.title: Qwen-Image (fp8)
variants.baseCompat: Qwen-Image text-to-image graph (20 steps, CFG 4) with the qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled text encoder and qwen_image_vae. About 20 GB of weights: more than a 16 GB card holds, so ComfyUI offloads part of them to system RAM (slower). Timed on an RTX 5080 16 GB: about 52 s for a 1024 x 1024 image once warm (67 s the first), with the card full; that is the cost of 20 GB of weights streaming through 16 GB, not a graph setting, and 40 transformer passes (20 steps at CFG 4).

families.reason: The GGUF build needs a GGUF loader node that PaRuX does not install or validate, so it is listed only; the supported Qwen-Image fp8 checkpoint covers the same model.

variants.title: Qwen-Image (GGUF Q4_K_M)
variants.baseCompat: Needs a GGUF loader node and the qwen_2.5_vl_7b text encoder.

variants.title: Qwen-Image-Edit (fp8)
variants.baseCompat: Qwen-Image-Edit instruction-edit graph (source image scaled to 1 megapixel, 20 steps, CFG 2.5) with the same qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled text encoder and qwen_image_vae as Qwen-Image, so installing both shares those two files. PaRuX cannot tell these weights from Qwen-Image's by their header: assign this file to editing, not the text-to-image checkpoint. About 20 GB of weights, offloaded to system RAM on a 16 GB card (slower; not yet timed on this PC).

families.reason: No Wan 2.2 14B workflow template (two-expert sampling, GGUF loader, audio-driven S2V) could be validated against a real ComfyUI in this build, so PaRuX does not run it yet.

variants.title: Wan 2.2 I2V 14B (fp8, high-noise expert)
variants.baseCompat: Two experts run one after the other; both files are needed. Size shown is for one expert.

variants.title: Wan 2.2 T2V 14B (fp8, high-noise expert)
variants.baseCompat: Two experts run one after the other; both files are needed. Size shown is for one expert.

variants.title: Wan 2.2 I2V 14B (GGUF Q4_K_M, high-noise expert)
variants.baseCompat: Needs a GGUF loader node and the matching low-noise expert.

variants.title: Wan 2.2 S2V 14B (audio-driven, fp8)
variants.baseCompat: Needs an audio encoder in addition to the text encoder and VAE.

variants.title: LTX-Video 2B v0.9.5
variants.license: OpenRAIL-M (LTX Video 2B 0.9.5 licence file in the repository: commercial use allowed, use-based restrictions apply)
variants.baseCompat: Single-file checkpoint (model and VAE in one file) with the t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled text encoder. Runs text-to-video and, for a start image or a continued clip, image-to-video. Clips are 9 to 97 frames (8n+1) at sizes that are multiples of 32; 768x512 is the native size. About 6.3 GB of weights, which fit a 16 GB card; not yet timed on this PC. Size, commit and digest were read from the repository listing.

families.reason: No ACE-Step music workflow template could be validated against a real ComfyUI in this build, so PaRuX does not run it yet.

variants.title: ACE-Step v1 3.5B
variants.baseCompat: All-in-one checkpoint (model, text encoder and music VAE).

families.reason: PaRuX speech engines are managed from the Speech settings, not through ComfyUI media routing, so this entry is informational only.

variants.title: Kokoro 82M v1.0
variants.baseCompat: Small enough for any PC; runs outside ComfyUI.

variants.title: SDXL base 1.0 (fp16)
variants.baseCompat: One file with both text encoders and the VAE inside, so nothing else is downloaded. Stability AI's own base model; ComfyUI's SDXL example uses 25 steps, CFG 7, dpmpp_2m with the karras scheduler. Native size 1024 x 1024.

variants.title: Juggernaut XL v9 (photoreal, fp16)
variants.baseCompat: Single-file photoreal SDXL fine-tune with text encoders and VAE inside. Its model card recommends DPM++ 2M Karras, 30-40 steps and CFG 3-7; PaRuX uses 35 steps and CFG 5.

variants.title: Animagine XL 4.0 (anime, fp16)
variants.promptPrefix: masterpiece, high score, great score, absurdres
variants.baseCompat: Single-file anime SDXL model that understands Danbooru-style tags. Its model card recommends Euler Ancestral, 28 steps and CFG 5, and ends prompts with the quality tags PaRuX adds for you.

variants.title: Pony Diffusion V6 XL (fp16)
variants.laneEvidence: Repository README (LyliaEngine/Pony_Diffusion_V6_XL): "Pony Diffusion V6 is a versatile SDXL finetune capable of producing stunning SFW and NSFW visuals of various anthro, feral, or humanoids species"; it also lists the tags rating_safe, rating_questionable and rating_explicit.
variants.license: Modified Fair AI Public License 1.0-SD per the card text (no monetised inference; the repository metadata says cdla-permissive-2.0)
variants.promptPrefix: score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up, score_6_up, score_5_up, score_4_up
variants.baseCompat: Community mirror of the CivitAI release; Runware/Pony_Diffusion_V6_XL holds a file with the identical SHA-256. Single file with text encoders and VAE inside. The card asks for the score_* tags (added for you) and Euler a with 25 steps.

variants.title: NoobAI XL 1.1 (anime, bf16)
variants.laneEvidence: Repository README (Laxhar/noobai-XL-1.1): front-matter tag "not-for-all-audiences"; recommended negative prompt begins "nsfw, worst quality, ..." and recommended prefix contains "safe", i.e. the model draws NSFW content unless told not to; trained on the full Danbooru and e621 datasets.
variants.license: Fair AI Public License 1.0-SD plus NoobAI terms (non-commercial use only; derivatives must be open)
variants.promptPrefix: masterpiece, best quality, newest, absurdres, highres
variants.baseCompat: Single-file SDXL anime model built on Illustrious-XL. Its card recommends Euler a, 25-30 steps and CFG 5-6. The card's own prefix also contains the tag safe; PaRuX leaves it out because this is the uncensored lane.

variants.title: RealVisXL V5.0 (photoreal, fp16)
variants.laneEvidence: Repository README (SG161222/RealVisXL_V5.0): "The model is aimed at photorealism. Can produce sfw and nsfw images of decent quality."
variants.baseCompat: Single-file photoreal SDXL model. Its card recommends DPM++ SDE Karras with 30 or more steps.

variants.title: FLUX.1 [schnell] (fp8, single file)
variants.baseCompat: Comfy-Org's single-file build: fp8 diffusion model plus CLIP-L, T5-XXL and VAE in one file, so nothing else is downloaded. Four steps, CFG 1 (no negative prompt). FLUX.1 [dev] is not offered: its licence is non-commercial.

variants.title: Chroma1-HD (bf16)
variants.laneEvidence: Repository README (lodestones/Chroma1-HD): "The model is released in a state as is and has not been aligned with a specific safety filter." and "It has the potential to generate content that may be considered harmful, explicit, or offensive."
variants.baseCompat: FLUX.1-schnell derivative without safety tuning. Needs the t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled text encoder (4.8 GB) and the FLUX ae VAE, both fetched with checksums. ComfyUI's Chroma graph: 26 steps, CFG 3.5, euler with the beta scheduler.

variants.title: Chroma1-HD (fp8 mixed, lower memory)
variants.laneEvidence: Repository README (silveroxides/Chroma1-HD-fp8-scaled, which reproduces the model card): "The model is released in a state as is and has not been aligned with a specific safety filter."
variants.baseCompat: The fp8 file ComfyUI's own Chroma template loads (byte-identical to Comfy-Org/Chroma1-HD_repackaged). Same text encoder and VAE as the bf16 file.
